ISH High School basketball

Students at ISH, the International School of Hellerup, train with Talata's own U15 and U17 players. Same court, same coaches, English on the floor.

When
Thursdays, 17:00 to 19:00 at Svanemøllehallen
Where
Svanemøllehallen, Østerbrogade 240, 2100 København Ø
Price
1.500 kr per half season, one training a week
Book a trial

Training with the club

High School students from ISH train with the rest of the club, on a court with players from different backgrounds, languages and countries. The language on the floor is English, so you feel at home from day one. More for English-speaking families.

The group takes the game and each other seriously. Players push each other in training and back each other up when it matters. You are coached by the same staff as our Academy squads, to the same standard, whatever you came for.

Start with one session a week. If you want to train more days, talk to us and we find the right level and days for you.

Details

Book a trial

Your first session is free. Come any Thursday, 17:00 to 19:00 at Svanemøllehallen, in trainers with water. Ready to join for the season? Email us and we set you up at the ISH rate of 1.500 kr per half-season.
